title: Where can I find my Application/Team/Server ID?
body:
Every Application, Team, and Server in Discord has a unique multi-digit ID. These IDs help our developer support team assist you more effectively. Let's learn how to find them!

Enable Developer Mode

Head into User Settings > Advanced & enable Developer Mode.

Application ID

The Application ID, also known as the Client ID, can be found in the Developer Portal in General Information. 

You also can find the Application ID by right-clicking on the bot user anywhere that it appears in the Discord Client.

Team ID

To get the Team ID you'll want to head into Developer Portal > Teams tab & go to the URL. The Team ID will be located here. 

Server ID / Guild ID

Right-click the server icon & select Copy ID. Double check if you have Developer Mode enabled if you're not seeing a Copy ID option.
